articles.summary: Season-long SEC football campaign features interactive fan experiences, coach and student-athlete storytelling, original video content and on-campus activations across the conference. Just in time for the college football season, Regions Bank on Thursday announced a new Southeastern Conference football campaign featuring on-campus game-day activations, fresh podcasts with student-athletes and coaches, a new commercial showing Regions’ pride in the SEC, and digital storytelling celebrating nearly 30 years of Regions serving as the Official Bank of the Southeastern Conference. Regions Bank is debuting a season-long SEC football campaign featuring interactive fan experiences, coach and student-athlete storytelling, original video content and on-campus activations across the conference.
